statement: Micron's data center segment reported $11.5B revenue, up 103% quarter-over-quarter, at an 87% gross margin.
why: A doubling of data center memory revenue in one quarter at an extreme gross margin is the clearest sign that memory demand is running far ahead of available supply.

impact.mechanism: Rapid revenue growth at exceptional margin indicates buyers are bidding up scarce memory, which raises accelerator bill-of-materials cost while confirming strong end demand.

evidence.excerpt: Micron data center segment gross margin reached 87% on $11.5B revenue

confidence.basis: Secondary open-web article restating segment figures; the underlying filing was not fetched and no multi-publisher corroboration is present.
